plugins.name: review-driven-development
plugins.description: Write every commit as a Conventional Commit, review the plan before any code exists (blueprint), execute it with parallel subagent waves (sprint), curate a large change's history into a readable narrative (split-pr), let a context-free reader narrate the diff until a stranger gets it right (cold-review), and split into complete PRs only when one is still too much to hold.
